name: RNA binding motif protein 39

function.text: RBM39 is the approved symbol for RNA binding motif protein 39. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in U1 snRNP binding; mRNA processing; regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Endometrial carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RBM39 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
